title: A Day at the Zoo
text: Last Sunday, I went to the zoo with my family. We saw a big elephant and a strong tiger. A monkey climbed up a tree, and a turtle walked very slowly. My favorite animal was the panda. It was eating leaves and looked very cute. We had a great day at the zoo!
